arms.E0: same semantic capacity; NULL tokens only
arms.E_text: same role-filtered English evidence and timing, no event category

cohort_rule: identical accepted source cohort and crop/noise schedule for all arms
semantic_encoder: minimal learned UTF-8 byte-mean embedding + category + separate time projection + attention; not a pretrained language encoder
sync: estimated offsets only inside recorded valid range; unresolved becomes content-only, never fabricated framewise timing
diagnostic_only: B=2, 64-frame actual TRAIN crops, 3 semantic-branch-only AdamW updates; base T0 frozen for this diagnostic
evaluation: same checkpoint and sampling strategy FRC80
dev_policy: frozen source-only automatic chain with same thresholds; no gold/listener substitution; no DEV tuning
transcript_setting: existing transcript-assisted; not an audio-only result
deployment_without_transcript: requires separately specified ASR or distillation; not implemented
